columns.<config_id>: true if matched under the endpoint rule
columns.<config_id> (localized): DeepSec, true if matched under localized recall; never union these with the others
columns.n_endpoint_aware_matched: how many of the seven endpoint-aware configurations matched it

basis: main runs; frozen reference set; vuln_id is the reference-set id in the public repository
derivation_note: One row per reference vulnerability. Produced by the VulnBench 2.0 analysis pipeline, which verifies the archive's SHA-256, extracts it, and re-scores every run with a re-implementation of the public scorer that reproduces every recorded scoring decision; this file is a selection and renaming of the pipeline's output.
empty_cells: An empty cell means not applicable or unavailable as stated in `columns`; it never means zero.
